Sql:
SELECT s."UnitateId", s."ContId", s."PartenerId", s."DocumentId"
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p."Unitate" AS "UnitateId", p."Cont" AS "ContId", p."Repartitor" AS "PartenerId", p."DocumentId"
    FROM "Postare" AS p
    INNER JOIN "Tranzactie" AS t ON p."TranzactieId" = t."ID"
    WHERE (p."Contrapondere" <> 4 OR p."Contrapondere" IS NULL) AND p."Spatiu" = 1 AND p."Carte" = 1 AND p."FelUnitate" = 2 AND p."Unitate" IS NOT NULL AND p."Repartitor" IS NOT NULL AND p."UnitateDeschisa" IS NOT NULL AND ((p."DocumentId" IS NULL AND t."Fel" = 4) OR (p."DocumentId" IS NOT NULL AND p."Unitate" = cub_partida_id(p."DocumentId", p."Cont", p."Repartitor")))
) AS s
ORDER BY s."UnitateId"
